appraisal_events.evidence: Je n'osai lui dire que je voulais tout subordonner à la possibilité de voir Mme de Stermaria.
appraisal_events.explanation: Though absent from the scene, Mme de Stermaria is privately marked by the narrator as his true priority, to which he is willing to subordinate everything, including the tender encounter he is presently in.

status_effects.explanation: Her privileged place in the narrator's unspoken desires elevates her local standing relative to the woman he is actually with, even though she does not appear directly in the passage.

ambiguities: The woman the narrator is speaking with throughout the passage is never named and does not correspond to any reviewed unnamed entity on the reference sheet, so she is omitted from characters_present per scope rules even though she is the direct addressee of nearly all the dialogue and the object of the passage's surface tenderness.

The reference sheet lists this figure only as 'Mlle de Stermaria', while the passage addresses her as 'Mme de Stermaria'; treated here as the same referent given the matching surname and the sheet's separate entry for her father ('M. de Stermaria').
